request_description: Architecture consisting of two virtual machines (vm_us_central1 and vm_europe_west2) running Linux, each with 2 CPUs, 4 GB RAM, and 50 GB disk. Both VMs are connected to a global VPC (global_vpc) spanning us-central1 and europe-west2 regions.
